meta.title: Token Architecture
meta.description: Layer 4: Defines the three-tier token output structure and complete component token map. When a palette is requested, the compiler runs all four layers in sequence and outputs primitives, semantic roles, and component tokens as a unified system. Component tokens reference semantic roles only — never layer-1 primitives directly.

layer-architecture.layer-1: Generation engine. Computes primitive ramp hex values from brand hue.
layer-architecture.layer-2: Semantic contract. Maps named roles to primitive stops. Defines hierarchy, direction, pairing.
layer-architecture.layer-3: Delta engine. Interaction state deltas, APCA correction, scale policy.
layer-architecture.layer-4: This file. Token architecture. Semantic role map + complete component token definitions.

when-palette-requested: 1. Run Layer 1 engine → produce primitive ramp values for all brand hues + greyscales
2. Resolve Layer 2 semantic roles → produce named semantic tokens with light/dark aliases
3. Apply Layer 3 deltas → produce interaction state tokens for all semantic fills
4. Apply Layer 4 component map → produce component tokens referencing semantic roles
5. Output all four tiers as a unified token system
output-contract.forbidden: Component tokens must never reference layer-1 primitives directly. Only semantic role names.

overlay-token-contract.description: Canonical reference for overlay token syntax, resolution, and constraints. Full contract in Layer 2 compiler-contract.overlay-token-contract.
overlay-token-contract.figma-implementation: Alias solid primitive variable → set opacity field. Do NOT create a solid colour with baked-in alpha.
overlay-token-contract.apca-hard-rule: Text MUST NOT be placed on any overlay token. Build error if violated.
overlay-token-contract.valid-opacity-range: 1–99. Use transparent keyword for 0%, use solid token for 100%.

changelog.1.2: CVD lightness separation fix (concern #1/#29). Dark mode success/error/warning fill stops offset to provide lightness-based differentiation under deuteranopia/protanopia simulation. Structural fix — hex-agnostic. Applies to any brand inputs. Stops: fill/success dark 300→100, fill/warning dark 300→400. Text/icon error dark 300→200, text/icon success dark 300→200, text/icon warning dark 300→400.

semantic-role-map.description: The authoritative mapping of semantic role names to their hierarchy weight and intent. Component tokens reference these names. This is the Layer 2 contract expressed as a named token vocabulary.

hierarchy-weights.1-background: Most recessive. Page canvas. Never competes with content.
hierarchy-weights.2-surface: Component canvas. Slightly elevated from background.
hierarchy-weights.3-surface-subtle: Inset or alternate surface. Between bg and surface.
hierarchy-weights.5-fill-subtle: Tinted fill. Chips, tags, selection highlights.
hierarchy-weights.7-text: Content layer. Always passes APCA against its paired surface.
hierarchy-weights.8-on-fill: Highest contrast. Text/icon on a coloured fill. Must pass Lc 75.

color/surface-overlay.desc: Standard modal/dialog backdrop. Text must NOT be placed on this token.
color/surface-overlay.apca-rule: NO_TEXT — overlay background. Pairs with solid surface-raised for dialog content.

color/fill/brand.desc: Primary brand fill — CTAs, active states

color/fill/error-subtle.desc: Error tint — banner bg, field bg

color/fill/success.desc: Success fill [light and dark stops updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/fill/warning.desc: Warning fill [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/fill/control.desc: Toggle track, slider rail, control bg

color/fill/inverse.desc: Inverse fill — dark chips in light, light in dark

color/text/error.desc: Error message text [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/text/success.desc: Success message text [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/text/warning.desc: Warning message text [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/icon/error.desc: Error icon [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/icon/success.desc: Success icon [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/icon/warning.desc: Warning icon [dark mode stop updated for CVD lightness separation]

color/on-fill/brand.desc: Text on primary brand fill. Must pass Lc 75.

color/on-fill/error.desc: Text on error fill. Must pass Lc 75.

color/on-fill/success.desc: Text on success fill. Must pass Lc 75.

color/on-fill/warning.desc: Text on warning fill. Must pass Lc 75.

color/on-fill/info.desc: Text on info fill. Must pass Lc 75.

color/surface-overlay-brand.desc: Brand-tinted highlight over images or selected list items.

color/surface-overlay-error.desc: Destructive flash or critical scrim over content.

color/surface-overlay-warning.desc: Warning tint over content — degraded state indication.

color/surface-overlay-selection.desc: List item selection highlight. 6% opacity preserves underlying text contrast.
color/surface-overlay-selection.apca-rule: LOW_OPACITY_EXCEPTION — opacity <= 8% does not meaningfully impact underlying solid surface contrast. Verify empirically.

semantic-role-map.floor-stop-note: Dark mode aliases in this file are calibrated for floor-stop 800 (L0.30, slate). If floor-stop changes, border and placeholder dark aliases must be re-verified against the new surface lightness. The Python compiler enforces this via fill-border-distinctness-policy and APCA audit.

component-tokens.description: Complete component token map. Every token references a semantic role from semantic-role-map. Compiler resolves: component-token → semantic-role → primitive-alias → hex.
component-tokens.reference-rule: Use semantic role names from semantic-role-map.roles keys. Never raw {ramp.stop} aliases here.

bg/focus.desc: Focus — ring applied via focus tokens

delta.note: Source is always a light container (L >= pivot). Apply darken only.

bg/active.desc: Active — steps up to primary fill

toast.desc: Transient notification. Default inverse + 4 semantic variants.

ring/color.desc: Focus ring — 2px, 2px offset. Source: Layer 2 interaction-tokens.

compiler-instructions.step-1-primitives: Run Layer 1 engine with brand hex inputs. Produce all ramp stops for pg, sg, primary, secondary, warning, success, info, error. Apply lightness profiles, chroma envelope, hue drift per family.
compiler-instructions.step-2-elevation: Read Layer 2 dark-mode-config.floor-stop. Compute elev.0–elev.4 hex values. Store as named tokens.
compiler-instructions.step-3-semantic: Resolve every entry in this file's semantic-role-map against the computed primitives. Each role gets a light hex and dark hex.
compiler-instructions.step-4-components: For each component in component-tokens, resolve the referenced semantic role names to their hex values. Apply Layer 3 deltas for state variants.
compiler-instructions.step-5-apca: Run APCA audit on all text-on-fill pairs. Apply Layer 3 apca-delta-correction-policy where needed. Set $extensions.verified per Layer 3 apca-extensions-audit-policy.
compiler-instructions.step-6-output: Emit three files: primitives.json (Layer 1 output), semantic-tokens.json (Layer 2+4 output), component-tokens.json (Layer 4 component output).
compiler-instructions.forbidden: Component tokens must never resolve to raw primitive aliases. They must always resolve through a semantic role.
compiler-instructions.redundancy-check: Before emitting, check for tokens with identical resolved hex values. Log as warnings. Do not auto-merge — flag for designer review.
compiler-instructions.dtcg-format: All output tokens use W3C Design Token format: { '$value': hex, '$type': 'color', '$extensions': { ... } }
compiler-instructions.step-3b-overlays: For every role with '@ {opacity}%' syntax in light or dark value: (1) resolve the base primitive alias to hex, (2) apply opacity to produce CSS color-mix output, (3) verify no text token is paired with this role as background — emit HARD BUILD ERROR if so, (4) log overlay token in build report.
